name: Satyam Mallik
headline:
From first idea.
To resilient product.
bio: I am a full-stack developer and creative technologist passionate about engineering performant web architectures and crafted user interfaces. Working across modern TypeScript ecosystems, distributed cloud APIs, and responsive design systems, I build reliable digital experiences that bridge design precision with engineering rigor.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.description: A unified campus collaboration network connecting students, clubs, and faculty. Features real-time notifications, event scheduling, peer resource sharing, and role-based discussions.

projects.title: Everyday Studio
projects.description: A minimalist productivity workspace and habit tracking tool designed with focus mode, local-first state caching, accessible keyboard shortcuts, and custom data visualizations.

projects.title: Personal Playground
projects.description: An interactive exploration of mathematical animations, micro-interactions, canvas shaders, generative SVG graphics, and performance profiling experiments.

education.detail: Core coursework in Data Structures, Database Systems, Computer Networks, Distributed Architecture, and Human-Computer Interaction.

experiences.detail: Engineered responsive web applications and backend microservices using TypeScript, Next.js, and Cloudflare Workers with strict end-to-end type safety.
Mentored peers in modern React and TypeScript best practices, organized technical workshops, and coordinated collaborative open-source projects.

achievements: Finalist — National Student Hackathon for Campus Connect Collaborative Platform (2025)
Dean’s List for Academic Merit & Technical Innovation (2024 — 2025)
Contributed to modern open-source UI libraries and developer utility toolkits
